note: SECOND PREDICATE for #3066, isolating ask D only: 'for store & loads from buffers/inputs/outputs, add the friendly name of the resource'. Present-symptom = the store instruction identifies its resource by an anonymous SSA handle, so a reader cannot tell which HLSL resource it writes without cross-referencing metadata by hand. Clause 3 is the symptom; clauses 1-2 are the self-test and they are what stop this from being a free absence. Clause 1 requires the g_luminanceOut row of the Resource Bindings table, which proves at once that a complete listing was produced, that the shader really did declare the resource (so the clause is not vacuously true on a shader that never mentions it) and that the compiler knows the friendly name it is not printing. Clause 2 requires the opcode annotator to have run. CONTROL: variant-zi-* (-Zi -Qembed_debug) scores no-match on ground truth and on v1.5.2010, because there the handle operand is '%g_luminanceOut_UAV_structbuf'; that is the proof this predicate detects the name when the name is printed. The primary match.json's clause matrix (manual-case-clause-matrix.txt) shows the same flip on v1.4.1907.

value.note: SELF-TEST: complete listing, resource declared, friendly name known to the compiler.
ask D symptom: the store's resource operand is an anonymous SSA value, not the resource's name.
